name: EN procurement call — approval gate, legal review pending
transcript:
[00:00:06] Rachel: Thank you for the proposal. Our business team is very interested in moving forward.
[00:00:13] Vendor: That is great to hear. Are there any remaining concerns?
[00:00:18] Rachel: Not on our side technically. However, I need to check with legal before we can commit to anything. Our legal team needs to review the data processing agreement.
[00:00:30] Vendor: Of course. Is there a timeline for the legal review?
[00:00:35] Rachel: Legal reviews typically take one to two weeks. I need to check with them to confirm. I cannot approve this myself — it is above my authority.
[00:00:46] Vendor: Understood. Is there anything we can do to expedite the process?
[00:00:51] Rachel: If you have a standard data processing agreement template we could use as a starting point, that would help speed things up.
[00:01:00] Vendor: Absolutely. I will send our standard DPA template by end of day.
[00:01:06] Rachel: Perfect. Once I have that I will pass it to legal and let you know their timeline.
[00:01:13] Vendor: Sounds good. We will wait for your confirmation before scheduling any next steps.

summary: Rachel's team is interested but legal review of the data processing agreement is required before commitment.
Rachel does not have authority to approve independently — legal clearance needed.
Vendor will send a standard DPA template today to accelerate the legal review.

action_items.task: Submit DPA to legal for review
Confirm legal review timeline to vendor
